properties.comment: PREDISPATCHINTERSENSITIVITIES sets out the sensitivity flows for each interconnector by period.

fields.doc: Unique identifier of predispatch run in the form YYYYMMDDPP with 01 at 04:30
fields.name: PREDISPATCHSEQNO

fields.doc: LP Solver Predispatch run no, typically 1. It increments if the case is re-run.
fields.name: RUNNO

fields.doc: Unique interconnector identifier
fields.name: INTERCONNECTORID

fields.doc: PERIODID is just a period count, starting from 1 for each predispatch run. Use DATETIME to determine half hour period.
fields.name: PERIODID

fields.doc: Flag to indicate if this result set was sourced from the pricing run (INTERVENTION=0) or the physical run (INTERVENTION=1). In the event that there is not intervention in the market, both pricing and physical runs correspond to INTERVENTION=0
fields.name: INTERVENTION

fields.doc: Period date and time
fields.name: DATETIME

fields.doc: Flag to indicate if the sensitivity run contains an active intervention constraint: 0 = No, 1 = Yes
